# Version 4.152.3
> **RAW decoding disabled** · Released September 29, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.3) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.3)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.3/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.203/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.3 disables RAW and DNG image decoding. Use a dedicated RAW-image decoder before passing supported raster data to SkiaSharp.

## Breaking Changes

- **RAW and DNG decoding disabled** — The bundled codec no longer decodes RAW or DNG images. Decode these formats with a dedicated library and provide a supported raster image to SkiaSharp instead. ([#5188](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5188))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.203

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
